item: Row 367 app-ai-tools batch B: model catalogue, backend panel, Ollama buttons, vLLM status and install follow a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-ai-tools.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; configs/innerhtml_unescaped_sinks.txt; tests/ai_tools_live_node_test.js; tests/ai_backend_select_race_node_test.js; tests/test_ai_settings_tab.py; tests/test_ai_tab_ux.py; tests/test_vllm_log_notes.py; tests/test_ai_install_protected_switch.py
summary: Six frozen renderers (loadModelCatalog, installOneModel, loadAiBackendPanel, launchOllama, loadVllmStatusPanel, installVllm) draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml. Click states are part of the render (_mcStarting, _ollBusy, _vllmInstalling); the catalogue and the vLLM install box are built bare per read with their parts held. A job's status line survives reads made while it runs, the read after its end draws it once, a later read drops it (it was wiped by the repaint that followed it). The override tick keeps the live value on a repaint. Bare job states go through t(). Fixes in passing: 'Active backend:' and 'Install vLLM' were English in every locale; the version is in translate=no; the dead write onto #vllm-start-btn (gone with startVllm, PRH-09) is removed. No new strings.
